name: Circadian Architecture
short_description: How architectural light exposure patterns entrain circadian rhythms, affecting physiological coordination, alertness cycles, and long-term health outcomes.

components.name: Photoentrainment
components.description: Architectural light spectrum, intensity, and timing drive circadian clock synchronization via ipRGC melanopsin pathways.

components.name: Subcortical Auditory Plasticity
components.description: Chronic acoustic environment shapes subcortical auditory processing with implications for cognitive health across the lifespan.

components.name: Temporal Processing Architecture
components.description: Architectural promenades and sequential spatial experiences create temporal prediction errors that structure the subjective experience of time.

design_implications: Provide high melanopic lux (>250 EML) during morning hours via east-facing glazing or tunable LED systems.
Reduce blue-enriched light exposure in evening spaces (bedrooms, residential areas).
Design daylight penetration to vary throughout the day, mimicking natural solar arc.
Consider light exposure duration and spectral content as a design variable, not just illuminance levels.

confidence_intervals.note: Effect sizes for circadian-aligned lighting on sleep quality, alertness, and mood.

basis: Inferred from molecule name: bridges circadian_lighting
